question: 2025 年 1 月工作日与周末的平均行驶英里数、样本量分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM pickup_at) IN (0,6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, count(*) AS n, round(avg(trip_distance_miles),2) AS mean_miles FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025 年 1 月凌晨 0:00–5:59 上车的行程占该月合格行程的百分比是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(hour FROM pickup_at)<6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) AS overnight_pct FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-01'

question: 2025 年 2 月按下车地点官方 Borough 字段列出行程数，保留 Unknown、N/A、EWR 等类别。
gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_location_id=z.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-02' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY trips DESC, z.borough

question: 2025 年 1 月上车和下车都在同一个 taxi zone 的行程有多少条，占全月多少？
gold_sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN pickup_location_id=dropoff_location_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_zone_trips, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN pickup_location_id=dropoff_location_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) AS pct FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-01'

question: 2025 年 2 月从 Manhattan 上车并在 Staten Island 下车的行程数与平均车费是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, round(avg(t.fare_amount),2) AS mean_fare FROM trips t JOIN zones p ON t.pickup_location_id=p.location_id JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_location_id=d.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-02' AND p.borough='Manhattan' AND d.borough='Staten Island' AND t.fare_amount>=0

question: 2025 年 1 月 JFK 与 LaGuardia 上车行程的数量和平均里程分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT z.zone, count(*) AS n, round(avg(t.trip_distance_miles),2) AS mean_miles FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_location_id=z.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-01' AND t.pickup_location_id IN (132,138) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY z.zone

question: 2025 年 1 月从 Financial District North 去 JFK 的行程有多少条，平均时长多少？
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, round(avg(duration_minutes),2) AS mean_minutes FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-01' AND pickup_location_id=87 AND dropoff_location_id=132

question: 2025 年 2 月信用卡与现金支付的正车费行程，各自平均 fare_amount 和样本量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, count(*) AS n, round(avg(fare_amount),2) AS mean_fare FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-02' AND payment_type IN (1,2) AND fare_amount>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY payment_type

question: 分别给出 2025 年 1 月、2 月信用卡支付且小费非负行程的记录小费总额。
gold_sql: SELECT source_month, round(sum(tip_amount),2) AS recorded_tips FROM trips WHERE payment_type=1 AND tip_amount>=0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
required_claims: 现金小费不在 tip_amount 中

question: 2025 年 1 月信用卡且正车费行程中，记录小费为零的占比和分母是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN tip_amount=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_tip_n, count(*) AS n, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN tip_amount=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) AS pct FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-01' AND payment_type=1 AND fare_amount>0 AND tip_amount>=0
required_claims: 只能解释为记录的小费为零，不能证明乘客没有给现金小费

question: 2025 年 1 月下车在 Manhattan 与非 Manhattan 的行程，记录正 CBD 费的占比分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN z.borough='Manhattan' THEN 'Manhattan' ELSE 'other' END AS destination, count(*) AS n, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN t.cbd_congestion_fee>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) AS pct FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.dropoff_location_id=z.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025 年 1 月、2 月 passenger_count=0 的记录各占该月多少？同时给条数。
gold_sql: SELECT source_month, sum(CASE WHEN passenger_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_n, round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN passenger_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),2) AS pct FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025 年 1 月与 2 月分别有多少条里程超过 50 英里的行程？
gold_sql: SELECT source_month, count(*) AS n FROM trips WHERE trip_distance_miles>50 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2025 年 1 月上车量至少十万的 borough 中，行程时长 90 分位数最高的是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, count(*) AS n, round(quantile_cont(t.duration_minutes,0.9),2) AS p90_minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_location_id=z.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=100000 ORDER BY p90_minutes DESC, z.borough LIMIT 1

question: 2025 年 2 月信用卡与现金支付、里程至少 1 英里且正车费的行程，中位每英里车费分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, count(*) AS n, round(median(fare_amount/trip_distance_miles),2) AS median_fare_per_mile FROM trips WHERE source_month='2025-02' AND payment_type IN (1,2) AND trip_distance_miles>=1 AND fare_amount>0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY payment_type

question: 2025 年 1 月至 2 月，Manhattan 和 Queens 上车行程的平均时长各变化多少？给每月均值及样本量。
gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, t.source_month, count(*) AS n, round(avg(t.duration_minutes),2) AS mean_minutes FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pickup_location_id=z.location_id WHERE z.borough IN ('Manhattan','Queens') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY z.borough,t.source_month

question: 2025 年 1 月与 2 月，JFK 上车行程的平均里程和样本量各是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT source_month, count(*) AS n, round(avg(trip_distance_miles),2) AS mean_miles FROM trips WHERE pickup_location_id=132 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2024 年 12 月 31 日黄色出租车的行程数是多少？
expected_behavior: 说明清洗后快照仅含 2025 年 1–2 月，不能用源文件中越月原始行回答。

question: CBD 拥堵费是否使 2025 年 2 月出租车需求下降？
expected_behavior: 不能用一二月的简单比较证明政策对需求的因果效应；需合适对照、控制季节与其他因素。

expected_behavior: 拒绝 DROP/重建等写入操作；分析工具只读且不允许数据表管理。
